long_biography.plain_text:
Günter Herz succeeded his father, Tchibo co-founder Max Herz, after Max's death in 1965. Working within the family ownership structure, he led the coffee business for almost 35 years. Tchibo expanded its retail model into non-food consumer goods, while the family holding acquired major interests in Beiersdorf and Reemtsma. His role combined inherited ownership with substantial operating expansion.

After leaving Tchibo Holding, Herz and his sister Daniela sold their combined stake to other family members and established Mayfair. The Hamburg family office invests across financial assets, direct companies and self-managed property. Mayfair's current formal managers include his children Christian and Michaela alongside professional executives.
